text:
maya: Quick planning thread for Optimize toolkit & evals roadmap next quarter. Need prioritization between batching/caching recommendations, regression alerts, and the curated prompt-set library. Also want clear launch criteria and a short scope for an MVP. Can folks drop constraints/customer asks by EOD Friday?

liam (Eng): +1 to prioritizing batching recs first — biggest near-term TCO wins for hosted customers. Caching is obviously high-impact too but requires infra work (cache placement + invalidation).

anita (Research): From eval perspective we need: canonical prompt sets, a small set of eval metrics (latency, token-cost, semantic-similarity), and a regression alert signal that ties to example prompts. Suggest starting with: 1) ROUGE/BERTScore proxy, 2) token delta, 3) latency pctiles.

tom (DevEx): Docs and examples are non-negotiable for adoption. Recommend a quickstart that shows: how to enable batching, one config snippet, and a tiny eval harness. Example config snippet:```yaml
optimize:
  batching:
    enabled: true
    max_batch_tokens: 2048
    target_latency_ms: 150
  caching:
    prefix_kv_cache: true
```

emma (Customer Success): Two mid-market customers already asked for per-route caching suggestions and the ability to canary quantized variants. They'll join pilot if we can promise a controlled rollout.

jen (Product Ops): Draft OKRs proposal for this initiative: - Reduce hosted per-token cost by 12% via batching & caching recommendations - Detect regressions within 24h of deploy - Ship prompt library with 20 curated prompt sets and examples for 3 domains (chat, summarization, RAG).

liam (Eng): Scope negotiation idea: MVP = batching recommendations engine + UI to surface suggested config + 10 seed prompt sets + one eval metric and a simulated regression alert. Stretch = automated cache placement tooling, full regression alerting pipeline, CLI + sample harness.

maya: Proposed launch criteria checklist (MUST):
- end-to-end recommend -> apply flow in Console (UX + backend)
- integration tests validating latency and cost improvements (bench harness)
- docs + quickstart examples published
- 3 pilot customers signed up and ran the flow
- regression alert fired in a mock test

deploy-bot: NOTE: staging rollout scheduled for roadmap/optimize/v0.1 on 2025-11-12T14:00:00Z (staging only) :construction: 

anita (Research): For prompt sets we should seed with diverse user intents: instruction-following, long-form summarization, retrieval-augmented Q&A, code-assist, and small-dialogue contexts. Each set should include 50-100 canonical examples if possible.

maya: Action items assigned: @liam -> draft technical spec & infra estimate by Tue; @anita -> propose evaluation metrics + seed prompts by Wed; @tom -> docs quickstart outline by Thu; @jen -> coordinate pilot customers and success criteria. I'll sync with sales on customer commitments.

liam (Eng): Sounds good. I'll include rough rollout timeline and a minimal API for programmatic recommendations.

tom (DevEx): I'll mock the quickstart README and one notebook. Keeping examples tiny will help adoption. :thumbsup:

jen (Product Ops): I'll line up the two CS contacts and a mid-enterprise pilot if needed.

maya: Thanks all — I'll consolidate into a short PRD and share before EOD Friday. If anyone has hard constraints (regulatory, infra blackout windows, etc.) please flag here.
